title: Electrospinning of methacrylated alginate for tissue engineering applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38746-38756
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07559E, Paper

Daria Poshina, Natalia Sokolova, Steve Nono-Tagne, Hamed Ahmadi-Nohadani, Iosif Gofman, Alexander Mishanin, Alexey Golovkin, Yury Skorik, Issei Otsuka
Photo-crosslinkable methacrylated alginate derivatives were electrospun and then irradiated by UV light to form cytocompatible fiber mats that are insoluble in water for a month, showing their potential application for tissue engineering.
